entities.summary: Melodía Ruiz Gutiérrez, best known by her stage name Melody, is a Spanish singer, songwriter, dancer, actress and model. Melody became famous at the age of 10 with her song "El baile del gorila", one of the biggest summer hits of 2001 in Spain. She has released six albums and numerous successful singles in the Spanish and Latin American markets. She represented Spain at the Eurovision Song Contest 2025 with the song "Esa diva", finishing in 24th place overall with 37 points.
